title: Travel Agents: Taiwan
subtitle: Your turn = ONE action. Larder caps at 7 ingredients (discard down at end of turn).

sections.heading: Do ONE action
lines: STOCK UP  —  take 2 ingredients where you stand (this region's specialties and/or pantry), then refill the Market.
TRAVEL  —  move to a neighbouring region, then take 1 ingredient there (North<->South by HSR).
PROMOTE  —  take 2 Buzz (the promotional currency; always available, never contested).
COURT A VENDOR  —  pay its cost, sign it to your tour, Season +1, rival locked out of it (see below).
EXTRACT  —  catch the last train home: trigger the end-game wind-down.

sections.heading: Courting cost & the ramp
lines: Pay:  named ingredients MINUS your matching region discount icons (floored at 0)  +  its Buzz (NEVER discounted).
Gain all at once:  Prestige (score up)  +  Reputation (marker up)  +  perk (usually a region discount icon)  +  Coverage tick if a new region.
Each discount icon you hold makes that region's ingredients 1 cheaper on future vendors — the engine. Buzz stays a fixed per-vendor tax.

sections.heading: Market events fire on refill
lines: After Stock Up / Travel, a flipped Event tile resolves now — festival boons, a typhoon reroute, a warm local. Boon-skewed; tax, never destroy.

sections.heading: End & score (reveal missions!)
lines: End trigger: someone EXTRACTS, OR the Season timer fills. (Reputation-top scores its +9 but does NOT end the game.)
Then finish the round + one more full round, then score.
Prestige (vendor stars)  +  Reputation end-VP (3/6/9/top -> +2/+4/+6/+9)  +  Coverage (2/3/4 regions -> 2/5/9)  +  secret Mission +7.
Most points = TOP AGENT.  Ties: highest Reputation, then most vendors, then most regions.
